summary.text: Paeonian whom Achilles slew beside Scamander in the rout that followed Asteropaeus' fall — one of the river-bank company named with Thersilochus and Mydon.

story.text: By the eddying Scamander, when the Paeonians' best man had fallen, swift Achilles drove them in flight along the banks and laid Astypylus in the dust with Thersilochus, Mydon, Mnesus, Thrasius, Aenius, and Ophelestes.
